description: Horizontal application menu bar built on Radix UI MenubarPrimitive. Supports nested sub-menus, checkbox items, radio groups, keyboard shortcuts, and separators. Includes a SurveyBuilderMenubar story demonstrating Survey, Edit, View, and Help menus.
useCases: Top-level application menu bar in the survey builder editor (Survey, Edit, View, Help)
Desktop-style menu navigation for complex multi-section applications
Keyboard-accessible command menus with shortcut annotations
Context-specific action bars for document or workspace management
